title: Epic Backfire: Karen Landlord Calls 911 On Herself, Arrested For Disorderly Conduct!
description:
On December 22nd, 2022, at around 12:16 pm, officers with in Ohio were dispatched to an apartment building where a woman was causing a disturbance. Upon arriving, officers found the woman involved, who appeared intoxicated, and began yelling and screaming at the officers.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with Disorderly Conduct.
